listeners.doc: Connects to a JMS broker and dispatches each delivered message to the attached service.

serviceTypes.doc: Consumes messages delivered from the queue or topic named in @jms:ServiceConfig.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked once per message delivered from the queue or topic named in @jms:ServiceConfig. Declare a narrower payload type to project the message payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

params.name: message
params.doc: The delivered message. Declare a narrower type to project the payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for explicit acknowledgement and transaction control. Needed only when the service's ackMode is CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE (for caller->ack) or SESSION_TRANSACTED (for caller->commit/caller->rollback).

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when a delivered message cannot be dispatched to onMessage, most commonly because its payload fails to bind to a declared narrowed payload type.
